title: Ride the High Country
description: Two aging ex-lawmen are hired to transport a shipment of gold from a mining camp into town after six miners were murdered attempting to transport the gold themselves.

title: Colorado Territory
description: After escaping from jail, outlaw Wes McQueen is convinced by his old partner in crime to do one last heist.

title: Stars in My Crown
description: Man of God Josiah Gray is determined to bring religion to the people of Walesburg, a dusty southern town still healing from the Civil War.

title: Stranger on Horseback
description: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town.

title: The Outriders
description: An escaped Confederate (Joel McCrea) and his two partners lead a wagon train of Union gold into an ambush.

title: The Most Dangerous Game
description: Mad Count Zaroff (Leslie Banks) gives a shipwrecked couple (Joel McCrea, Fay Wray) a knife, then hunts them with hounds and a bow and arrows.

title: My Forbidden Past
description: An 1890s New Orleans heiress tries to buy a married doctor's love with her tainted family fortune.

title: Lone Star
description: A Texas cattle baron (Clark Gable) fights a state senator's (Broderick Crawford) politics and steals his newspaper-editor girlfriend (Ava Gardner).

title: The Little Hut
description: An upper-class English couple (Ava Gardner, Stewart Granger) and their bachelor friend (David Niven) are shipwrecked on a desert isle.

title: Bhowani Junction
description: A British colonel (Stewart Granger) falls in love with an Anglo-Indian woman (Ava Gardner) in World War II India.

title: The Naked Maja
description: Love takes precedence over art and politics as Spanish painter Goya (Anthony Franciosa) pines for an aloof duchess (Ava Gardner).

title: Seven Days in May
description: An aide (Kirk Douglas) discovers his general's (Burt Lancaster) Pentagon plot and tells the president (Fredric March).

title: The Life and Times of Judge Roy Bean
description: A small-time outlaw takes over a town by dispensing his own form of justice and confiscating property for court costs.

title: Mogambo
description: A chorus girl (Ava Gardner) and a married woman (Grace Kelly) fight over a white hunter (Clark Gable) in Africa.

title: The Night of the Iguana
description: In Mexico, a defrocked clergyman (Richard Burton) juggles relationships with three women of disparate personalities.

title: The Barefoot Contessa
description: Flashbacks at a funeral reveal how a Madrid nightclub dancer was propelled to instant stardom and eventual misfortune.

title: 55 Days at Peking
description: Soldiers from 11 countries and a Marine major (Charlton Heston) guard a besieged compound during the Boxer Rebellion.

title: Louisiana Story
description: A Cajun boy (Joseph Boudreaux) and his parents (Lionel Le Blanc, Mrs. E. Bienvenu) live in the bayou with alligators and oil drillers.

title: Carnival Story
description: Willie (Anne Baxter), a German woman, joins an American carnival passing through Munich. While traveling town to town, she joins Frank in his high-dive act, but tragedy is only a slip away.

title: Exclusive Story
description: A reporter helps a kindly old shopkeeper fight off racketeers who want his store.

title: The FBI Story
description: An agent (James Stewart) with a worried wife (Vera Miles) stays 25 years fighting the Ku Klux Klan, gangsters, Nazi spies.

title: Gangster Story
description: An upstart gangster (Walter Matthau) moves in on another's (Bruce McFarlan) territory.

title: Tall Story
description: Gamblers, a coed (Jane Fonda) and an ethics exam force answers from a college basketball player (Anthony Perkins).

title: The Stratton Story
description: Inspired by his wife and son, Chicago White Sox player Monty Stratton pitches with an artificial leg.

title: The Philadelphia Story
description: A snooty socialite (Katharine Hepburn) fights with her ex-husband (Cary Grant) and flirts with a reporter (James Stewart).

title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
description: The Sherwood Forest outlaw (Errol Flynn) and his men save King Richard and Maid Marian (Olivia de Havilland) from Prince John and Sir Guy (Basil Rathbone).

title: Captain Blood
description: A British doctor (Errol Flynn) sold into slavery becomes a dashing Caribbean pirate and fights a duel with a French pirate (Basil Rathbone) to win a woman (Olivia de Havilland).

title: The Scarlet Pimpernel
description: London dandy Sir Percy (Leslie Howard) dons disguises to save French nobles from the Reign of Terror guillotine.

title: The Prisoner of Zenda
description: Court followers foil a plot by having a British look-alike (Ronald Colman) pose as the king of Ruritania.

title: The Prince and the Pauper
description: An adventurer (Errol Flynn) saves the day after Tudor Prince Edward (Robert J. Mauch) and a look-alike (Billy Mauch) trade places.

title: The Three Musketeers
description: D'Artagnan (Walter Abel) joins swordsmen Athos (Paul Lukas), Porthos and Aramis in the service of Louis XIII.

title: Treasure Island
description: Robert Louis Stevenson's pirate Long John Silver (Wallace Beery) wants young Jim Hawkins' (Jackie Cooper) map.

title: The Bachelor Father
description: Crusty Sir Basil invites his illegitimate children, including a daughter who wants to fly across the Atlantic, to visit him at his manor house.

title: Bachelor Apartment
description: A New York playboy (Lowell Sherman) dates wild women until he falls for a hard-working stenographer (Irene Dunne).

title: Bachelor Bait
description: A marriage license clerk, tired of just handing out licenses, opens a lonely-hearts club and winds up getting a wife.

title: Married Bachelor
description: A man (Robert Young) leaves his wife (Ruth Hussey) to maintain his pose as bachelor author of a marriage manual.

title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
description: A judge (Myrna Loy) orders a playboy (Cary Grant) to date her infatuated teenage sister (Shirley Temple) to cure the girl's crush on him.

title: Bachelor in Paradise
description: An advice-to-the-lovelorn writer (Bob Hope) falls for the only single girl (Lana Turner) in a town full of women.

title: Atlantic City
description: A boardwalk numbers runner feels young again with a casino clam shucker and a lucky cocaine deal.

title: Bull Durham
description: A literary baseball groupie (Susan Sarandon) romances a pitcher (Tim Robbins) and a catcher (Kevin Costner) on a minor-league North Carolina team.

title: Dead Man Walking
description: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

title: The Front Page
description: The managing editor (Walter Matthau) of a 1920s Chicago paper stalls his ace reporter (Jack Lemmon) with a story.

title: The Hunger
description: A kinky couple (Catherine Deneuve, David Bowie) from Manhattan satisfy their vampire thirst with victims in discotheques.

title: Salt of the Earth
description: A Mexican-American couple's troubles are intensified when the husband becomes involved in a major labor dispute.

title: Modern Times
description: In Chaplin's classic comedy of the Machine Age, a bolt tightener (Charlie Chaplin) fails at everything but falling in love.
